what: Columbia Banking System owns Umpqua Bank, lending to businesses and households across the American Northwest and California after the 2023 merger of Columbia and Umpqua, and the 2025 Pacific Premier deal.
customers: Small and mid-sized businesses and households in Oregon, Washington, Idaho, California and Arizona.
money: commercial and consumer lending funded by deposits
treasury management, card and wealth services
moat: A dense branch and relationship network across the Northwest, where it is one of the few banks of scale not headquartered on the East Coast.
risks: Two large mergers in three years, each carrying integration and customer-retention risk
Commercial real estate exposure in West Coast markets
opportunities: 9.9 times earnings with a 23.9% net margin and $1.4B of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $1.3B to $2.3B in four years through the mergers
Analysts see about 16% upside, with 15 covering the stock
watch: Deposit retention after the mergers and the net interest margin.
